destination: disposable local public-evidence directory, never production
stopConditions: Any RPC error, missing history, oversized response, time or request/byte budget exhaustion
Unknown program layout, unrecognized account write, ambiguous state reconstruction
captureRequirements: Record full PoolState/config, both mints/vaults and loader/program-data before a future aligned UTC minute, with finalized context slots
Retain full deployed binary hash and independent reproducible build attestation; a 45-byte header is insufficient
Collect getBlocks plus every produced finalized full getBlock from before state snapshot through the closing boundary; validate parentSlot/previousBlockhash chain
Independently bracket and enumerate both pool signature streams; cross-check every successful AND failed pool-reference transaction against full blocks
Retain all pool/config/mint/program writes and reconstruct state from pre-window snapshot with pinned decoders; before/after snapshots alone cannot prove intervening configuration
Track Token-2022 scaled-multiplier effective timestamps and transfer-fee epochs during the window; reject unsupported changes/fees
Persist hash-addressed receipts, canonical tx indices, invocation/transfer reconciliation and resource measurements before deriving OHLCV
limitations: The RPC endpoint is currently denied by proxy CONNECT 403. A normal network-policy allowlist change by the environment operator is required before another attempt; no endpoint substitutions
Even with network access, free RPC and before/after snapshots alone do not supply reproducible binary attestation or a complete account-state decoder
A single accepted minute cannot establish a complete 5m or 1h bucket; capture and prove every constituent minute
Budgets are hard caps, not predictions or a provider quota guarantee; a busy minute can exceed the byte cap and must remain UNKNOWN
